samples.question: A horizontal timeline of five panels reads left to right. The leftmost panel is the START queue: a row of colored discs (red, green, blue, or orange), read left to right, with the FRONT of the queue at the very left. The four panels to the right are OPERATOR panels, read left to right in order. An operator panel showing a colored disc means ENQUEUE: that disc's color is appended to the BACK (right end) of the queue. An operator panel showing only a dark left-pointing arrow means DEQUEUE: the FRONT (leftmost) disc is removed and every remaining disc shifts left, so a new disc becomes the front. The queue is never drawn again; replay the operators from the START queue. What color is at the FRONT of the final queue? Answer 'red', 'green', 'blue', 'orange', or 'empty'.
